item.title: 🔵 FortiBleed campaign used custom FortiGate sniffer to steal credentials
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.
Security firm SOCRadar says the large-scale FortiBleed campaign targeting Fortinet FortiGate devices used custom sniffers to harvest authentication secrets from compromised firewalls and steal credentials. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 2h ago
